name: final-assignment-api-automation
description: Postman + Newman API test automation for Script Labs (labs.hendri.me) with GitHub Actions CI/CD

scripts.test:crud: newman run collections/script-labs-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json --folder "01 - Auth" --folder "02 - Auth Negative" --folder "03 - Labs CRUD" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/crud-report.html
scripts.test:ddt: newman run collections/script-labs-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json --folder "01 - Auth" --folder "04 - Data-Driven (CSV)" -d data/labs-data.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/ddt-report.html
scripts.test: npm run test:crud && npm run test:ddt
